purpose: Precisely classify the already reproduced implicit rows alias error; no source reread

results.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM (VALUES (1)) AS sample(value)
SELECT count(*) total FROM (VALUES (1)) AS sample(value)

cause: Implicit unquoted rows alias with omitted AS fails in this context; explicit AS rows and quoted rows work. It is incorrect to classify ROWS as a reserved keyword.
fix: Use explicit AS row_count in the summary
